verdict.rationale: A government business-filing service could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only the SOSPortal web filing, search and ordering features, how-to guides and videos, and downloadable PDF forms. Nothing shows a public API, API reference, or runnable examples, so the verdict is none.
